title: Node
description: TOGAF-sourced structural archetype — deployment location hosting technology and application components. An active system that hosts other Structures and provides compute/network/storage Mechanisms. Extends Structure with TOGAF Technology Architecture vocabulary. TOGAF mapping: Node (Content Metamodel, Technology Architecture domain). Source framework: TOGAF (Technology Architecture, Content Framework).

nodeType.description: Deployment node type. TOGAF mapping: Node classification in Technology Architecture deployment view.

location.description: Physical or logical deployment location (data center, region, availability zone). TOGAF mapping: Node location.

environment.description: Deployment environment classification. TOGAF mapping: Technology Architecture deployment environment.
